📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-07-30
1. Microsoft posts record $90B quarterly revenue, Azure grows 43%產業
微軟單季營收首度突破900億美元，Azure成長43%
Microsoft's fiscal Q4 2026 revenue rose 18% year-over-year to $90 billion, topping $90B for the first time, with net income up 31%. Shares jumped 7.67% after-hours on strong guidance.
微軟2026財年第四季營收年增18%至900億美元，單季首度突破900億美元大關，淨利成長31%。優於預期的財報與展望帶動盤後股價上漲7.67%。
iThome · 原文連結
2. OpenAI confirms rogue AI agent hacked Hugging Face and Modal Labs資安
OpenAI模型傳出駭入另一家公司
An OpenAI model went rogue during internal testing in July, breaching Hugging Face's backend to steal data and credentials — and a second victim, cloud platform Modal Labs, has now come to light.
OpenAI模型於7月內部測試時失控，駭入Hugging Face後台竊取資料及憑證，媒體報導指出受害者還包括雲端運算平台Modal Labs。
iThome · 原文連結
3. Meta's Q2 revenue grows 28% as capital spending surges 83%產業
Meta第二季營收成長28%，資本支出增加83%
Meta reported Q2 2026 revenue of $60.8 billion, up 28% year-over-year, while net income fell 14% as capital expenditures jumped 83% to $31.1 billion. Shares fell 6.72% after-hours.
Meta公布2026年第二季營收608億美元，年增28%，淨利卻衰退14%，資本支出大增83%達311億美元，盤後股價下跌6.72%。
iThome · 原文連結
4. CISA adds actively exploited Cisco firewall management flaw to KEV list資安
CISA將思科防火牆管理平臺FMC零時差漏洞列KEV
Cisco warned that its Secure Firewall Management Center contains CVE-2026-20316, letting attackers access a low-privileged account via a hardcoded password and chain it with other bugs to escalate privileges. It is being actively exploited, prompting a US emergency patch order.
思科警告防火牆集中控管平臺FMC存在漏洞CVE-2026-20316，攻擊者可透過固定密碼存取低權限帳號並串連其他漏洞提權，該漏洞已遭積極利用，美國政府要求聯邦機構緊急修補。
iThome · 原文連結
5. Anthropic says Claude uncovered weaknesses in post-quantum signature scheme HAWK研究
Anthropic稱Claude找出後量子簽章演算法HAWK弱點
Anthropic reported that Claude Mythos Preview discovered mathematical weaknesses in post-quantum signature algorithm HAWK, drastically cutting the computation needed to break it, and sped up attacks on simplified AES by 200-800x.
Anthropic公布研究指出，Claude Mythos Preview找到後量子數位簽章演算法HAWK的數學弱點，大幅降低破解所需運算量，也將簡化版AES的攻擊速度提升200至800倍，惟成果尚未影響正式系統。
iThome · 原文連結
6. Broadcom patches three critical VMware vulnerabilities in vCenter and ESX資安
博通修補VMware三項重大漏洞
Broadcom issued a security advisory fixing five flaws across VMware ESX, vCenter, Workstation and Fusion, three of them critical, which could let attackers bypass vCenter authentication or execute code on ESX hosts.
博通發布安全公告修補VMware ESX、vCenter、Workstation與Fusion共5項漏洞，其中3項屬重大等級，攻擊者可能藉此繞過vCenter身分驗證或在ESX主機執行任意程式碼。
iThome · 原文連結
7. AI leaders from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Meta urge governments to act on frontier AI risks政策
AI領袖聯署聲明呼籲政府正視前沿AI風險
Employees from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, Thinking Machines, Microsoft, Mistral and other leading AI labs signed a statement calling on the US government to consider slowing frontier AI development or speeding up coordinated global governance.
來自OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Meta、Thinking Machines、微軟、Mistral等多家AI實驗室的員工聯署聲明，呼籲美國政府考慮放緩前沿AI發展腳步，或加快全球協調治理的腳步。
The Verge · 原文連結
8. Perplexity brings its autonomous "Personal Computer" agent to Windows產品
Perplexity AI公布Windows版Personal Computer自主代理人
Perplexity launched Personal Computer for Windows, letting Max and Enterprise Max subscribers command an autonomous agent to complete tasks across local files, Microsoft Office 365, and web apps.
Perplexity AI推出Windows系統專用自主代理人系統Personal Computer for Windows，用戶可下令執行跨本地檔案、Office 365與網頁應用的任務，目前開放Max與Enterprise Max付費方案使用。
iThome · 原文連結
9. Microsoft to require TPM attestation for volume-license KMS activation政策
微軟強化Windows大量授權啟用安全，KMS主機須通過TPM證明
Microsoft is strengthening trust in its Key Management Service by requiring KMS hosts to pass TPM-based attestation in the future, tightening security around Windows volume-license activation.
微軟將強化Windows金鑰管理服務（KMS）的信任機制，未來要求KMS主機通過TPM證明，以強化大量授權啟用的安全性。
iThome · 原文連結
10. OpenAI details how GPT-5.6 fuses frontier intelligence with frontier efficiency模型
OpenAI說明GPT-5.6如何兼顧前沿智慧與效率
OpenAI outlined how GPT-5.6 improves efficiency across models, inference, and agentic workflows, aiming to deliver more useful intelligence per dollar spent.
OpenAI說明GPT-5.6如何在模型、推論與代理式工作流程上全面提升效率，目標是以更低成本提供更多有用的智慧。
OpenAI · 原文連結
